valid.name: no-fees
valid.note: plain order, fill pays seller net = price

valid.name: fees-all-paid
valid.note: royalty 5% + market 2% (50/50 listing/settlement), all paid, venue tag present

valid.name: fees-dropped
valid.note: same order, buyer drops all fee outputs: still a valid fill, fee_split_ok=false

valid.name: p2sh-payto-expiry-share
valid.note: pay_to P2SH, expiry set, listing_share 3000, no settlement tag (settlement_fee_ok = null)

valid.name: embedded-psdt
valid.note: optional psdt field equals the canonical rebuild

valid.name: asig-valid
valid.note: asig over the canonical op (fees, listing_to, expiry covered): any inscriber may publish it; verify with Core verifymessage(asig_address, asig, asig_message)

invalid.name: price-number
invalid.why: price must be a decimal string

invalid.name: hijack-non-owner-key
invalid.why: sig is valid for the attacker key but the dog prevout is P2PKH(seller); dojak builder: dog output is not P2PKH of the signer key

invalid.name: asig-tampered-fee
invalid.why: listing_to swapped after signing; SINGLE sig still valid (net unchanged) but asig fails

invalid.name: asig-wrong-key
invalid.why: asig is a valid signature, but by the attacker key, not the order pubkey

invalid.name: asig-replay-other-dog
invalid.why: valid order for a different dog by the same seller, with asig copied from asig-valid (inscription_id/utxo/sig are covered)

invalid.name: asig-high-s
invalid.why: same signature with s → n−s (and flipped recid): mathematically valid, rejected as non low-S

invalid.name: duplicate-key
invalid.why: pay_to appears twice; last-wins parsers see a valid order (dojak: duplicate JSON key "pay_to" at 294)

ordering.name: newer-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: ts +60 on the same outpoint replaces

ordering.name: older-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: third party re-inscribes the older (higher-fee or cheaper) order: rejected

ordering.name: equal-ts-same-outpoint
ordering.why: equal ts: the first one seen in chain order stays

ordering.name: identical-reinscription
ordering.why: re-inscribing the active order is a no-op

ordering.name: older-ts-other-outpoint
ordering.why: a different outpoint is not compared (the old outpoint is already gone)
